call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Organic Order Growth >100% and Liquid Cooling Capacity
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Giordano, congratulations on organic orders doubling year-over-year. Could you give us more granularity on how much of this order surge is driven by liquid cooling versus traditional power/thermal, and what is your current manufacturing lead time for complete converged modular infrastructure?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Giordano Albertazzi explained that while liquid cooling demand is growing exponentially with high-density AI clusters, traditional air and hybrid power systems also saw immense growth because customers are retrofitting existing facilities. Lead times for standardized modular power solutions have actually compressed by 30% due to capacity additions in North America and Europe, while Vertiv's proprietary CoolTera CDUs and manifold systems are scaling rapidly to meet hyperscaler deployment deadlines.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: After-Hours Digestion (-2.8%) vs. Supply Chain & Margins into 2027
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: David, the print was exceptional across every single metric, yet the stock is taking a modest breather in the aftermarket (-2.8%). Is there any concern that gross margin at 29.97% or adjusted operating margin at 25.2% is nearing a cyclical peak as more hardware volume ramps, or do you see structural operating leverage continuing into 2027?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO David Fallon addressed margin dynamics directly: 'We do not see 25% adjusted operating margin as a ceiling. As our product mix continues to tilt toward integrated high-value liquid-to-air heat exchangers, busways, and converged power pods, software monitoring, and lifecycle spares, our value capture expands. The aftermarket reaction simply reflects a stock that has appreciated tremendously year-to-date digesting a monster quarter.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: With Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta all signaling sustained CapEx increases through 2027, how far out does Vertiv's current backlog extend, and are you seeing any signs of double-ordering or capacity hoarding among colocation providers?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Albertazzi stated that Vertiv's order validation process requires firm customer site engineering approvals and financial commitments, preventing speculative phantom backlog. Visibility extends comfortably through the entirety of 2027, with multi-gigawatt pipeline discussions underway for modular installations scheduled for late 2027 and 2028.
